target.title: docs(signal): document --signal-number, --http-host, --http-port CLI flags
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators using `openclaw channels add --channel signal` with CLI flags had no documentation explaining what `--signal-number`, `--http-host`, and `--http-port` do.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Signal channel plugin declares these three flags in `package.json` (`cliAddOptions`) so the non-interactive setup wizard accepts them, but `docs/channels/signal.md` did not mention them. Each flag now has a one-line description and the default value where applicable, matching the existing channel documentation pattern used by googlechat.

## User Impact

Operators can now look up what each Signal CLI flag does directly in the docs instead of trial-and-error or reading source code.

## Evidence

Docs-only change. The flag names, descriptions, and default values are verified against:

- `extensions/signal/package.json` — `cliAddOptions` declarations
- `docs/channels/signal.md` — existing config field docs (lines 73, 168, 421) confirm `127.0.0.1:8080` defaults
